notes: Node-geometry GPU transport: the native nodeGpu receipts of one canonical frame (BBLITE_NODE_GPU_CAPTURE=1) joined against the browser observation and the generated asset: raw attribute bytes, index sequences, texture/sampler sharing per material, per-view bindings, and world uploads exact to the word except signed zeros. The observation's init script (checks/plugins/scene149-identity.init.js) gives every WebGPU object an identity and records every buffer's bytes, bind group and pipeline and two submissions' draws; the source hook hands it the scene's material map, which it resolves to each node material's albedo texture, view, sampler and meshes.
